_comment: Sound effects for the narration recordings (npm run sfx → content/sfx/preview/). 'sounds': one entry per sound, generated once with ElevenLabs Sound Effects from 'prompt' ('seconds' 0.5–30, 'loop' for beds), or 'file' for your own recording. 'files': cues per recording. A cue is anchored to a phrase of the text ('at', or 'start'); 'edge' start|end picks the start or end of that phrase, 'offset' shifts it in seconds, 'gain' is the level in dB relative to the voice: every sound is first matched to the voice's average level, so 0 = as loud as the voice and -10 = clearly in the background, whatever the generated file's own loudness. 'to' (a phrase or 'end') turns the cue into a looped bed. 'repeat' plays it several times: 'every' seconds apart, 'anchor' last = the last one lands on the phrase, 'gainFrom' = level of the first one. 'trim' cuts a sound to that many seconds. Days 3 and 22: no clock strikes or ticking in the narration, those are the puzzles.
